result.reason: The clause adds the preferred USD 5M cyber/privacy coverage and retains statutory workers’ compensation and certificates on request. However, it does not require the prescribed USD 2M CGL aggregate; it states only USD 1M without distinguishing per-occurrence and aggregate limits. The USD 1M E&O limit meets the fallback, but the unchanged description tying E&O to bodily injury and property damage is imprecise. The cyber trigger also extends to any Confidential Information rather than only Customer Data processing, making it broader than necessary. The margin comment cannot cure these operative-language deficiencies.
